name: Fuxie_Character_v18_motion_polish_rig
source_note: V18 keeps V17's contour-cut source identity mesh and retunes all animation clips for source-locked motion: smaller joint rotations, stable feet/torso, softer tail/ear/head accents, and less texture warping. It is still a 2.5D source-locked approximation, not a recovered original 3D mesh.

idle.description: Motion-polished 60fps idle: tiny breathing, stable torso, soft head/ear/tail accents.

wave.description: Motion-polished wave: readable hand greeting without over-warping the source-locked arm.

talk.description: Motion-polished talk: subtle jaw, head nod, and small hand cue.

listen.description: Motion-polished listen: attentive head tilt and ear focus with stable feet.

reward.description: Motion-polished reward: small game mascot bounce with contained arm/tail motion.

tryAgain.description: Motion-polished encouragement: gentle nod and small hand cue, no sad slump.

stats.target_runtime: 60fps WebGL contour source mesh with motion-polished clips

limits: V18 improves clip believability for the current source-locked rig, but does not solve missing true side/back volume.
Large production-quality limb arcs still require a full 3D mesh or manually separated/painted volume surfaces.
Tail edge cleanup remains limited by the source cutout until the atlas is manually painted.
next_step: Browser QA V18 against V17. If motion is accepted, use V18 as current live candidate and continue tail/edge cleanup.
